title: Emit-mode loop machine
statement: Given finite Boolean Turing machines $B$ and $F$ and a state $a$ of $B$, the emit-loop machine is the loop-host construction applied to $B$, $F$, and $a$ in emit mode.
caveat: The definition of the loop-host construction is not included, so its behavior cannot be specified more fully from the provided statement.
